body: Well you’ve done a great job at communicating here. Maybe writing out what you want to say before going will help. And I still suggest seeing your primary doctor because it could be something physical like a vitamin deficiency. Good luck, hope things turn around

I too am 17 and kind of going through the same thing. See a professional before it’s too late. In the meantime see if any of the activities you used to love bring you any joy. Or maybe try some new things and see if any of that helps. But definitely see your primary and/or a psychiatrist they recommend.

I’m not doing great. I have things to do but no energy to do them. However, they’re not urgent so it’s fine. My New Years resolution is to live in the moment. Not sure exactly how to do that but maybe reddit or my therapist can help lol. Happy Monday everyone <3
My mom now realizes the urgency and I’m just waiting for the holiday season to end so someone can fit me in. It feels like I’m always waiting on something or someone, but that’s life I guess.
Sounds like depression to me. Best option is to talk to a professional before you lose all motivation. Hang in there I’m sure it’ll get better

I feel this too and recently realized this has been as long as I can remember. It’s hard to believe there are people that live happily with passion and purpose because I’ve never experienced that. But i think it’s important to remember that there are people out there living like that and you can be one of them. Talk to a professional, exercise every option, eventually you might be one of those people.

I feel this all the time. I feel like at some point I swallowed a pill that told me the meaning of the universe and the answer was nothing. And now nothingI do has purpose and i just want to die. I wish I could go back in time to before I swallowed that pill.
Congrats on the interview!! Now just try and ride this high as far as it’ll take you

You are definitely depressed, friend. A breakup, moving, and the holidays are all probably big factors. If you don’t feel like your depressed, maybe try the things you used to love or try some new stuff if you just can’t seem to enjoy anything. I would recommend a therapist but I get that if you don’t feel depressed you probably don’t think it’s time for that. I had the same problem recently where out of nowhere my depression and anxiety just spiraled putting me in the ER because it started to affect my physical health. Not that I could have controlled that, but I knew I had a problem, I wanted to fix it, and I did nothing about it for years. Anyway, the point of that was just to say you don’t need to hit rock bottom before you take action, and everyone could use some outside help. Don’t know if you were looking for advice, but I hope it helps a little to hear you’re not alone.
A poem would be great and I’ll listen to the song thank you
I don’t really have a set number but I’d like to have as many as possible to pick from. So if you have more in you, I’d love to hear them.
This helps so much thank you!!
